<p>A <b>llama</b> is a <a href="/w/Taming#List_of_mobs" title="Taming">tameable</a> <a href="/w/Neutral_mob" class="mw-redirect" title="Neutral mob">neutral mob</a> that can be equipped with a <a href="/w/Chest" title="Chest">chest</a> to transport <a href="/w/Item" title="Item">items</a>, and can wear <a href="/w/Carpet" title="Carpet">carpets</a> for decoration. If attacked, it will retaliate using its <a href="/w/Spit" class="mw-redirect" title="Spit">spit</a>.
</p>

<div class="mw-heading mw-heading2"><h2 id="Spawning">Spawning</h2><span class="mw-editsection"><span class="mw-editsection-bracket">[</span><a href="/w/Llama?section=1&veaction=edit" title="Edit section: Spawning" class="mw-editsection-visualeditor"><span>edit</span></a><span class="mw-editsection-divider"> | </span><a href="/w/Llama?action=edit&section=1" title="Edit section's source code: Spawning"><span>edit source</span></a><span class="mw-editsection-bracket">]</span></span></div>
<p>A llama spawns above light level 7 on <a href="/w/Grass_block" class="mw-redirect" title="Grass block">grass blocks</a> in <a href="/w/Savanna_plateau" class="mw-redirect" title="Savanna plateau">savanna plateau</a>, <a href="/w/Savanna" title="Savanna">savanna</a>‌<sup class="nowrap Inline-Template" title="">[<i><span title="This statement only applies to Bedrock Edition"><a href="/w/Bedrock_Edition" title="Bedrock Edition">BE</a>  only</span></i>]</sup><sup id="cite_ref-1" class="reference"><a href="#cite_note-1"><span class="cite-bracket">[</span>1<span class="cite-bracket">]</span></a></sup> or <a href="/w/Windswept_savanna" class="mw-redirect" title="Windswept savanna">windswept savanna</a>‌<sup class="nowrap Inline-Template" title="">[<i><span title="This statement only applies to Bedrock Edition"><a href="/w/Bedrock_Edition" title="Bedrock Edition">BE</a>  only</span></i>]</sup> <a href="/w/Biome" title="Biome">biomes</a> in herds of 4 llamas, and in <a href="/w/Windswept_hills" class="mw-redirect" title="Windswept hills">windswept hills</a>, <a href="/w/Windswept_forest" class="mw-redirect" title="Windswept forest">windswept forest</a>, and <a href="/w/Windswept_gravelly_hills" class="mw-redirect" title="Windswept gravelly hills">windswept gravelly hills</a> biomes in herds of 4 to 6 llamas, coming in four coat colors: white, cream, gray, or brown.
</p><p>10% of llamas spawn as baby llamas.
</p>

<p>Like other baby animals, killing a baby llama yields no <a href="/w/Item" title="Item">item</a> or <a href="/w/Experience" title="Experience">experience</a>.
</p>
<div class="mw-heading mw-heading2"><h2 id="Behavior">Behavior</h2><span class="mw-editsection"><span class="mw-editsection-bracket">[</span><a href="/w/Llama?section=5&veaction=edit" title="Edit section: Behavior" class="mw-editsection-visualeditor"><span>edit</span></a><span class="mw-editsection-divider"> | </span><a href="/w/Llama?action=edit&section=5" title="Edit section's source code: Behavior"><span>edit source</span></a><span class="mw-editsection-bracket">]</span></span></div>
<p>Llamas are <a href="/w/Neutral_mobs" class="mw-redirect" title="Neutral mobs">neutral mobs</a> that retaliate when attacked by a <a href="/w/Player" title="Player">player</a> or another <a href="/w/Mob" title="Mob">mob</a>. Occasionally, their <a href="/w/Spit" class="mw-redirect" title="Spit">spit</a> can miss its intended target and accidentally hit another llama, causing them to fight each other.
</p><p>Llamas are hostile toward wolves and spit without provocation, but they don't attack tamed wolves unless provoked. Wolves are fearful of llamas of <a href="#Data_values">strength</a> 4 or 5 and always run away, and won't attack unless provoked by their spit.<sup id="cite_ref-2" class="reference"><a href="#cite_note-2"><span class="cite-bracket">[</span>2<span class="cite-bracket">]</span></a></sup> Wolves flee from weaker llamas less often. Tamed wolves never flee from llamas.
</p><p>Llamas are completely passive in <a href="/w/Peaceful" class="mw-redirect" title="Peaceful">Peaceful</a> difficulty.
</p><p>Llamas float when in water deeper than two blocks.
</p><p>Llamas can safely fall 6 blocks before they begin to accumulate <a href="/w/Fall_damage" class="mw-redirect" title="Fall damage">fall damage</a>, unlike most mobs, which can only safely fall 3 blocks. Llamas also take half of the normal fall damage (rounded up) that most other mobs take (0.5<span class="hidden-alt-text">HP</span><span class="nowrap mc-hearts"><span class="iconbar pixel-image nowrap" style="--icon-offset:-1px;" title="1 heart"><span typeof="mw:File"><span><img alt="❤️" src="/images/Heart_%28icon%29.png?faf83" decoding="async" loading="lazy" width="9" height="9" class="mw-file-element" data-file-width="9" data-file-height="9"></span></span></span> × 0.25</span> damage per block over the safe distance instead of 1<span class="hidden-alt-text">HP</span><span class="nowrap mc-hearts"><span class="iconbar pixel-image nowrap" style="--icon-offset:-1px;" title="0.5 hearts"><span typeof="mw:File"><span><img alt="💔" src="/images/Half_Heart_%28icon%29.png?cb16e" decoding="async" loading="lazy" width="9" height="9" class="mw-file-element" data-file-width="9" data-file-height="9"></span></span></span></span>). If an entity is riding a llama, they receive the same fall damage as the llama.
</p><p>Llamas have a <sup>1</sup>⁄<sub>900</sub> chance to regenerate 1<span class="hidden-alt-text">HP</span><span class="nowrap mc-hearts"><span class="iconbar pixel-image nowrap" style="--icon-offset:-1px;" title="0.5 hearts"><span typeof="mw:File"><span><img alt="💔" src="/images/Half_Heart_%28icon%29.png?cb16e" decoding="async" loading="lazy" width="9" height="9" class="mw-file-element" data-file-width="9" data-file-height="9"></span></span></span></span> health point each game tick.
</p><p>Unlike other neutral mobs, llamas don't count towards the <code>AngryAt</code> tag.<sup id="cite_ref-3" class="reference"><a href="#cite_note-3"><span class="cite-bracket">[</span>3<span class="cite-bracket">]</span></a></sup><sup id="cite_ref-4" class="reference"><a href="#cite_note-4"><span class="cite-bracket">[</span>4<span class="cite-bracket">]</span></a></sup><sup id="cite_ref-5" class="reference"><a href="#cite_note-5"><span class="cite-bracket">[</span>5<span class="cite-bracket">]</span></a></sup>
</p>
<div class="mw-heading mw-heading3"><h3 id="Spitting">Spitting</h3><span class="mw-editsection"><span class="mw-editsection-bracket">[</span><a href="/w/Llama?section=6&veaction=edit" title="Edit section: Spitting" class="mw-editsection-visualeditor"><span>edit</span></a><span class="mw-editsection-divider"> | </span><a href="/w/Llama?action=edit&section=6" title="Edit section's source code: Spitting"><span>edit source</span></a><span class="mw-editsection-bracket">]</span></span></div>
<p><span class="anchor" id="Llama_spit"></span>
</p>
<div role="note" class="hatnote searchaux">Main article: <a href="/w/Llama_Spit" title="Llama Spit">Llama spit</a></div>
<p>Llamas attack other mobs by spitting at them, dealing 1<span class="hidden-alt-text">HP</span><span class="nowrap mc-hearts"><span class="iconbar pixel-image nowrap" style="--icon-offset:-1px;" title="0.5 hearts"><span typeof="mw:File"><span><img alt="💔" src="/images/Half_Heart_%28icon%29.png?cb16e" decoding="async" loading="lazy" width="9" height="9" class="mw-file-element" data-file-width="9" data-file-height="9"></span></span></span></span> <a href="/w/Damage" title="Damage">damage</a>. <a href="/w/Llama_spit" class="mw-redirect" title="Llama spit">Llama spit</a> is not flammable. In <a href="/w/Bedrock_Edition" title="Bedrock Edition"><i>Bedrock Edition</i></a>, like other <a href="/w/Projectiles" class="mw-redirect" title="Projectiles">projectiles</a>, it can be thrown back at the llama.
</p>
<div class="mw-heading mw-heading3"><h3 id="Taming">Taming</h3><span class="mw-editsection"><span class="mw-editsection-bracket">[</span><a href="/w/Llama?section=7&veaction=edit" title="Edit section: Taming" class="mw-editsection-visualeditor"><span>edit</span></a><span class="mw-editsection-divider"> | </span><a href="/w/Llama?action=edit&section=7" title="Edit section's source code: Taming"><span>edit source</span></a><span class="mw-editsection-bracket">]</span></span></div>
<p>Llamas can be tamed by repetitively riding them until hearts are displayed, done by pressing <span class="explain" title="Defaults to right click on mouse or left trigger on controller.">use</span> on the llama while holding nothing.
</p><p>Taming success depends on the llama's <code>Temper</code> value. <code>Temper</code> is a positive trait, with higher values increasing the chance of successful taming. Llamas begin with a <code>Temper</code> value of 0 and a maximum of 30. When a player rides an untamed llama, a random number from 0 to 29 is chosen. The llama gets tamed successfully if this number is less than the <code>Temper</code> value, otherwise, the <code>Temper</code> is increased by 5 and the player is bucked off. <code>Temper</code> can also be increased by feeding the llama.
</p><p>Tamed llamas do not spit at mobs that attack its owner, although it spits at any mob that attacks the llama. Tamed llamas can still retaliate at players should the player hit them.
</p><p>Feeding a llama food can alter its behavior, increasing its temper value if untamed, restoring lost health or making a baby grow faster (babies ordinarily take around 20 minutes to mature to adults). The table below lists the effects of the 2 food items llamas accept.
</p><p>A llama can be fed by holding a valid food item and pressing <span class="explain" title="Defaults to right click on mouse or left trigger on controller.">use</span> while facing the llama. Llamas can be fed only when feeding would have an effect, similar to other animals. If the food is invalid, the player mounts the llama instead.
</p>

<div class="mw-heading mw-heading3"><h3 id="Breeding_2">Breeding</h3><span class="mw-editsection"><span class="mw-editsection-bracket">[</span><a href="/w/Llama?section=8&veaction=edit" title="Edit section: Breeding" class="mw-editsection-visualeditor"><span>edit</span></a><span class="mw-editsection-divider"> | </span><a href="/w/Llama?action=edit&section=8" title="Edit section's source code: Breeding"><span>edit source</span></a><span class="mw-editsection-bracket">]</span></span></div>
<p>Adult tamed llamas can be bred by being fed a <a href="/w/Hay_bale" class="mw-redirect" title="Hay bale">hay bale</a>. The baby llama takes on the coat color of one parent at random. Its strength is chosen as a random integer between 1 and the strength of the stronger parent, inclusive. 3% of the time the resulting strength is increased by 1, but it is capped at 5.
</p>

<p>Select a row based on the stronger parent. The column shows the probability of the resulting offspring having a given strength.  
</p><p>A llama's base health (15<span class="hidden-alt-text">HP</span><span class="nowrap mc-hearts"><span class="iconbar pixel-image nowrap" style="--icon-offset:-1px;" title="1 heart"><span typeof="mw:File"><span><img alt="❤️" src="/images/Heart_%28icon%29.png?faf83" decoding="async" loading="lazy" width="9" height="9" class="mw-file-element" data-file-width="9" data-file-height="9"></span></span></span> × 7.5</span> to 30<span class="hidden-alt-text">HP</span><span class="nowrap mc-hearts"><span class="iconbar pixel-image nowrap" style="--icon-offset:-1px;" title="1 heart"><span typeof="mw:File"><span><img alt="❤️" src="/images/Heart_%28icon%29.png?faf83" decoding="async" loading="lazy" width="9" height="9" class="mw-file-element" data-file-width="9" data-file-height="9"></span></span></span> × 15</span>) is calculated based on that of its parents, in the same way as a <a href="/w/Horse" title="Horse">horse</a>'s.
</p><p>Color variant of llama is randomly selected between parents.
</p><p>When breeding a trader llama with a normal llama in Java Edition, the offspring will always be a normal llama. In Bedrock Edition, the offspring can be either normal or trader llama.
</p>
<div class="mw-heading mw-heading3"><h3 id="Caravans">Caravans</h3><span class="mw-editsection"><span class="mw-editsection-bracket">[</span><a href="/w/Llama?section=9&veaction=edit" title="Edit section: Caravans" class="mw-editsection-visualeditor"><span>edit</span></a><span class="mw-editsection-divider"> | </span><a href="/w/Llama?action=edit&section=9" title="Edit section's source code: Caravans"><span>edit source</span></a><span class="mw-editsection-bracket">]</span></span></div>
<p>Llamas form a caravan when one of them is <a href="/w/Lead" title="Lead">leashed</a> by a <a href="/w/Player" title="Player">player</a>.
</p><p>Leashing a llama causes up to nine nearby llamas that are not already in a caravan to follow it, forming a caravan of up to ten llamas. When multiple llamas are leashed, each leashed llama can lead its own caravan of up to ten llamas. A caravan cannot contain more than one leashed llama, and there is no limit to the number of caravans a player can lead.
</p>
<div class="mw-heading mw-heading3"><h3 id="Storage">Storage</h3><span class="mw-editsection"><span class="mw-editsection-bracket">[</span><a href="/w/Llama?section=10&veaction=edit" title="Edit section: Storage" class="mw-editsection-visualeditor"><span>edit</span></a><span class="mw-editsection-divider"> | </span><a href="/w/Llama?action=edit&section=10" title="Edit section's source code: Storage"><span>edit source</span></a><span class="mw-editsection-bracket">]</span></span></div>
<figure class="mw-default-size mw-halign-right" typeof="mw:File/Thumb"><a href="/w/File:Llama_GUI_Strength_4.png" class="mw-file-description"><img src="/images/thumb/Llama_GUI_Strength_4.png/300px-Llama_GUI_Strength_4.png?edba0" decoding="async" loading="lazy" width="300" height="283" class="mw-file-element" srcset="/images/Llama_GUI_Strength_4.png?edba0 2x" data-file-width="352" data-file-height="332"></a><figcaption>The GUI of a llama with strength 4 and with a chest.</figcaption></figure>
<p>A tamed llama can be equipped with a <a href="/w/Chest" title="Chest">chest</a> by pressing the <span class="explain" title="Defaults to right click on mouse or left trigger on controller.">use</span> control on it while holding a chest. The chest gives the llama 3 to 15 slots of inventory space, depending on its strength (see table below). Once equipped, its contents can be accessed by pressing the <span class="explain" title="Defaults to right click on mouse or left trigger on controller.">use</span> control on the llama while <a href="/w/Sneaking" title="Sneaking">sneaking</a>, or by opening the inventory while riding the llama. The chest itself cannot be retrieved without <a href="/w/Killing" class="mw-redirect" title="Killing">killing</a> the llama.
</p>

<div class="mw-heading mw-heading3"><h3 id="Carpets">Carpets</h3><span class="mw-editsection"><span class="mw-editsection-bracket">[</span><a href="/w/Llama?section=11&veaction=edit" title="Edit section: Carpets" class="mw-editsection-visualeditor"><span>edit</span></a><span class="mw-editsection-divider"> | </span><a href="/w/Llama?action=edit&section=11" title="Edit section's source code: Carpets"><span>edit source</span></a><span class="mw-editsection-bracket">]</span></span></div>
<figure class="mw-halign-right" typeof="mw:File/Thumb"><a href="/w/File:All_Llama_swag_patterns.png" class="mw-file-description"><img src="/images/thumb/All_Llama_swag_patterns.png/350px-All_Llama_swag_patterns.png?fd1c5" decoding="async" loading="lazy" width="350" height="365" class="mw-file-element" srcset="/images/thumb/All_Llama_swag_patterns.png/700px-All_Llama_swag_patterns.png?fd1c5 2x" data-file-width="1920" data-file-height="2002"></a><figcaption>All llama carpet patterns.</figcaption></figure>
<p>A tamed llama can be equipped with a wool <a href="/w/Carpet" title="Carpet">carpet</a> in its carpet slot. Each carpet color shows as a different patterned rug when on the llama's back. This can be useful for color-coding the llamas as storage containers, like dyed <a href="/w/Shulker_box" class="mw-redirect" title="Shulker box">shulker boxes</a>.
</p><p>When given carpets, all types of llamas look the same, except for their fur colors. In <a href="/w/Java_Edition" title="Java Edition"><i>Java Edition</i></a>, a llama's carpet decoration, including the default blue rug of a trader llama, remains visible when the llama is under the effect of <a href="/w/Invisibility" title="Invisibility">Invisibility</a>;<sup id="cite_ref-6" class="reference"><a href="#cite_note-6"><span class="cite-bracket">[</span>6<span class="cite-bracket">]</span></a></sup> in <a href="/w/Bedrock_Edition" title="Bedrock Edition"><i>Bedrock Edition</i></a>, it becomes invisible.
</p><p>For the purposes of the <code><span>/<a href="/w/Commands/item" title="Commands/item">item</a></span></code> <a href="/w/Commands" title="Commands">command</a>, a llama carries its carpet in the <code>armor.body</code> slot.
</p>

<div role="note" class="hatnote searchaux">Main article: <a href="/w/Entity_format" title="Entity format">Entity format</a></div>
<p>Llamas have entity data associated with them that contain various properties.
</p>
<div class="treeview">
<ul><li><span title="NBT Compound / JSON Object"><span class="sprite nbt-sprite" style="background-position:-48px -16px;background-size:64px auto;height:16px;width:16px"></span><span class="hidden-alt-text">[NBT Compound / JSON Object]</span></span> Entity data
<ul><li class="mw-empty-elt"></li><li class="treeview-header nbttree-inherited load-page" data-page="Template:Nbt inherit/breedable/template" data-template="true" data-treeview="true" data-treeviewclass="nbttree-inherited">Additional fields for mobs that can breed<span class="noscript"> see <a href="/w/Template:Nbt_inherit/breedable/template" title="Template:Nbt inherit/breedable/template">Template:Nbt inherit/breedable/template</a></span><span class="mw-editsection-like load-page-button" style="min-width: 38px;">[<span class="jslink">show</span>]</span></li>
<li class="mw-empty-elt"></li><li class="treeview-header nbttree-inherited load-page" data-page="Template:Nbt inherit/entity/template" data-template="true" data-treeview="true" data-treeviewclass="nbttree-inherited">Tags common to all entities<span class="noscript"> see <a href="/w/Template:Nbt_inherit/entity/template" title="Template:Nbt inherit/entity/template">Template:Nbt inherit/entity/template</a></span><span class="mw-editsection-like load-page-button" style="min-width: 38px;">[<span class="jslink">show</span>]</span></li>
<li class="mw-empty-elt"></li><li class="treeview-header nbttree-inherited load-page" data-page="Template:Nbt inherit/mob/template" data-template="true" data-treeview="true" data-treeviewclass="nbttree-inherited">Tags common to all mobs<span class="noscript"> see <a href="/w/Template:Nbt_inherit/mob/template" title="Template:Nbt inherit/mob/template">Template:Nbt inherit/mob/template</a></span><span class="mw-editsection-like load-page-button" style="min-width: 38px;">[<span class="jslink">show</span>]</span></li>
<li><span title="Byte"><span class="sprite nbt-sprite" style="background-position:-0px -0px;background-size:64px auto;height:16px;width:16px"></span><span class="hidden-alt-text">[Byte]</span></span><span class="nowrap" style="font-weight: bold;"> Bred</span>: 1 or 0 (true/false) – Unknown. Remains 0 after breeding. If true, causes it to stay near other horses with this flag set.</li>
<li><span title="Byte"><span class="sprite nbt-sprite" style="background-position:-0px -0px;background-size:64px auto;height:16px;width:16px"></span><span class="hidden-alt-text">[Byte]</span></span><span class="nowrap" style="font-weight: bold;"> EatingHaystack</span>: 1 or 0 (true/false) – true if the mob is eating grass.</li>
<li><span title="Int Array"><span class="sprite nbt-sprite" style="background-position:-16px -32px;background-size:64px auto;height:16px;width:16px"></span><span class="hidden-alt-text">[Int Array]</span></span><span class="nowrap" style="font-weight: bold;"> Owner</span>: The <a href="/w/UUID" title="UUID">UUID</a> of the entity that tamed the mob, stored as four ints. Has no effect on behavior. Does not exist if there is no owner.</li>
<li><span title="Byte"><span class="sprite nbt-sprite" style="background-position:-0px -0px;background-size:64px auto;height:16px;width:16px"></span><span class="hidden-alt-text">[Byte]</span></span><span class="nowrap" style="font-weight: bold;"> Tame</span>: 1 or 0 (true/false) – true if the mob is tamed.</li>
<li><span title="Int"><span class="sprite nbt-sprite" style="background-position:-48px -0px;background-size:64px auto;height:16px;width:16px"></span><span class="hidden-alt-text">[Int]</span></span><span class="nowrap" style="font-weight: bold;"> Temper</span>: Ranges from 0 to 30; increases with feeding. Higher values make a mob easier to tame.</li>
<li><span title="Byte"><span class="sprite nbt-sprite" style="background-position:-0px -0px;background-size:64px auto;height:16px;width:16px"></span><span class="hidden-alt-text">[Byte]</span></span><span class="nowrap" style="font-weight: bold;"> ChestedHorse</span>: 1 or 0 (true/false) - true if the llama has chests.</li>
<li><span title="Int"><span class="sprite nbt-sprite" style="background-position:-48px -0px;background-size:64px auto;height:16px;width:16px"></span><span class="hidden-alt-text">[Int]</span></span><span class="nowrap" style="font-weight: bold;"> DespawnDelay</span>: A timer for trader llamas to despawn, present only in <code>trader_llama</code>. The trader llama despawns when this value reaches 0.</li>
<li><span title="NBT List / JSON Array"><span class="sprite nbt-sprite" style="background-position:-32px -32px;background-size:64px auto;height:16px;width:16px"></span><span class="hidden-alt-text">[NBT List / JSON Array]</span></span><span class="nowrap" style="font-weight: bold;"> Items</span>: List of items. Exists only if <code>ChestedHorse</code> is true.
<ul><li><span title="NBT Compound / JSON Object"><span class="sprite nbt-sprite" style="background-position:-48px -16px;background-size:64px auto;height:16px;width:16px"></span><span class="hidden-alt-text">[NBT Compound / JSON Object]</span></span> An item, including the Slot tag.
<ul><li class="mw-empty-elt"></li><li class="treeview-header nbttree-inherited load-page" data-page="Template:Nbt inherit/item/template" data-template="true" data-treeview="true" data-treeviewclass="nbttree-inherited">An item stack in a container slot<span class="noscript"> see <a href="/w/Template:Nbt_inherit/item/template" title="Template:Nbt inherit/item/template">Template:Nbt inherit/item/template</a></span><span class="mw-editsection-like load-page-button" style="min-width: 38px;">[<span class="jslink">show</span>]</span></li></ul></li></ul></li>
<li><span title="Int"><span class="sprite nbt-sprite" style="background-position:-48px -0px;background-size:64px auto;height:16px;width:16px"></span><span class="hidden-alt-text">[Int]</span></span><span class="nowrap" style="font-weight: bold;"> Strength</span>: Ranges from 1 to 5, defaults to 3.  Determines the number of items the llama can carry (items = 3 × strength).  Also increases the tendency of wolves to run away when attacked by llama spit. Strengths 4 and 5 always causes a wolf to flee.</li>
<li><span title="Int"><span class="sprite nbt-sprite" style="background-position:-48px -0px;background-size:64px auto;height:16px;width:16px"></span><span class="hidden-alt-text">[Int]</span></span><span class="nowrap" style="font-weight: bold;"> Variant</span>: The variant of the llama. Represents the <a href="/w/Data_component_format#llama/variant" title="Data component format">minecraft:llama/variant</a> component.</li></ul></li></ul>
</div>

<div class="mw-heading mw-heading2"><h2 id="Trivia">Trivia</h2><span class="mw-editsection"><span class="mw-editsection-bracket">[</span><a href="/w/Llama?section=26&veaction=edit" title="Edit section: Trivia" class="mw-editsection-visualeditor"><span>edit</span></a><span class="mw-editsection-divider"> | </span><a href="/w/Llama?action=edit&section=26" title="Edit section's source code: Trivia"><span>edit source</span></a><span class="mw-editsection-bracket">]</span></span></div>
<ul><li>Some carpets on a llama's back represent certain mobs; a green carpet uses the face of the green <a href="/w/Creeper" title="Creeper">creeper</a>, while a purple carpet gains eyes like those of an <a href="/w/Enderman" title="Enderman">enderman</a>. A llama wearing a gray carpet has a mask, similar to that of a superhero or a bandit.</li>
<li>The llama was the first mob that <a href="/w/Agnes_Larsson" title="Agnes Larsson">Agnes Larsson</a> designed. She visited a real-life llama named Adrian to use as a model.<sup id="cite_ref-8" class="reference"><a href="#cite_note-8"><span class="cite-bracket">[</span>8<span class="cite-bracket">]</span></a></sup></li></ul>
